title: Hyperinvariant subspaces of hyponormal operators: A constructive decomposition approach
summary: It is shown that any hyponormal operator on an infinite-dimensional separable Hilbert space that admits a decomposition \( T = R + V \), where \( R \) is tridiagonal and \( V \) is trace-class, has nontrivial closed hyperinvariant subspaces provided $T$ is not a multiple of the identity. We further discuss implications of this result for the invariant subspace problem of hyponormal operators answering, in particular, negatively to a question raised by Kim and Lee \cite{kimlee} regarding an explicit approach to such a problem.
